# Execution quality · Wednesday 11 Nov 2026 (session = `@day`)
Sign convention: **positive = market moved in our favour after the fill**, negative = against us. Slippage = markout at offset 0 (aggressive fills pay about the half-spread, passive fills earn it). Markouts are mid on the fill's own venue at +1m/+5m/+15m; `*_usd` columns are the mark-to-market of the day's fills at that horizon. Change `day` / `prev_day` / `spike` in the Variables popover to reuse tomorrow (e.g. `'$yesterday'`).

## Findings for 11 Nov 2026
1. **Yes, we were picked off, and it was concentrated in one episode.** The gas complex (NBP, TTF, JKM, UK power) rallied 3–4% in a near-straight line from **09:30 to 09:50 UTC** (NBP_Dec-26 206 → 222 p/th, settlement 219.3 vs 203.0 the day before, so the move is real). From 09:00 the desk was a heavy net **seller** of NBP (-3.9M therms 09:00–09:40) and about 60% of that was **passive offers that were lifted as the market ran through them** (trader_10, trader_13, trader_11, trader_20). 30-minute markout of NBP + UK power sells in 09:00–10:00: about **-$330k**. See the spike chart and fills table below.
2. **Outside the spike, the exchange flow is clean.** Aggressive fills pay ≈ the half-spread on every venue (CME 0.95 vs 0.93 bps, ICE 1.21 vs 1.24, ICE Endex 1.27 vs 1.39, EEX 2.47 vs 2.51) and passive fills earn it. Oil (Brent/WTI) markouts are positive at 5–15 min on both styles. Ex-spike, NBP passive is flat (+0.5 bps at 5m, t = 0.3).
3. **Persistent, smaller problems:** UK power aggressive fills on ICE are -6.0 bps at 5m ex-spike (n = 86, t = -3.1), driven by trader_19 and trader_20; Gasoil (PRODUCTS book, 100% aggressive, traders 05–08) pays 1.5 bps with no reversion, i.e. pure spread cost on $420M/day.
4. **OTC / broker counterparties (2-day sample):** flow from **INDUSTRIAL_xx via brokers** (-4.6 bps at 5m, t = -3.8; -10.9 bps at 30m, t = -2.9) and **UTILITY_xx via OTC** (-5.5 bps at 5m, t = -3.9) moves against us right after the trade; BANK flow via brokers moves in our favour. Per name the samples are 3–14 trades, so treat the per-counterparty table as a watch-list (INDUSTRIAL_08, UTILITY_09/10, PRODUCER_05), not a verdict.
5. **Things that look wrong but are not execution problems:** (a) **EEX quotes are not independent of fills**: every EEX fill has a quote exactly 1 ns before it at the fill price, so EEX slippage is tautologically ±half-spread and its 0–5 s markouts are meaningless; EEX also had a 3-minute feed gap 08:45–08:48. (b) **Stale quotes on illiquid tenors** (quarters/seasons): 14 TTF fills and 7 UK power fills had a venue quote older than 60 s (max 15 min), which makes their row-level markouts noisy. (c) **Booking latency**: OTC trades were booked on average 5.4 h after trade time, 26 of 101 on the next day, 11 trades were amended/cancelled after the fact (2 price corrections) – a book-as-of/risk problem, not a fill-quality one.

WITH m AS (
  SELECT f.venue, f.passive, f.symbol, h.offset / 1000000000 AS horizon_s, count() AS n,
    sum(CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / f.px * 10000) AS sum_bps,
    sum(CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(f.qty)) AS pnl_local,
    sum(abs(f.qty) * f.px) AS notional_local,
    sum((q.ask - q.bid) / (q.bid + q.ask) * 10000) AS sum_hs
  FROM energy_fills f HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source) LIST (0, 60s, 300s, 900s) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @day
), j AS (
  SELECT m.venue, m.passive, m.horizon_s, sum(m.n) AS n, sum(m.sum_bps) / sum(m.n) AS avg_bps,
         sum(m.pnl_local * u.factor) AS pnl_usd, sum(m.notional_local * u.factor) AS notional_usd, sum(m.sum_hs) / sum(m.n) AS hs
  FROM m JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON u.symbol = m.symbol
)
SELECT venue, CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS style, max(n) AS fills,
       round(max(notional_usd) / 1000000, 1) AS notional_musd, round(max(hs), 2) AS half_spread_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 0 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS slippage_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 60 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_1m_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_5m_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 900 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_15m_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 0 THEN pnl_usd ELSE 0 END)) AS slippage_usd,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN pnl_usd ELSE 0 END)) AS markout_5m_usd,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 900 THEN pnl_usd ELSE 0 END)) AS markout_15m_usd
FROM j ORDER BY venue, style

WITH r AS (
  SELECT hour(f.ts) AS hr, f.passive,
    CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / f.px * 10000 AS bps
  FROM energy_fills f HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source) LIST (300s) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @day
)
SELECT hr AS hour_utc, round(avg(CASE WHEN passive = false THEN bps END), 2) AS aggressive_5m_bps, round(avg(CASE WHEN passive THEN bps END), 2) AS passive_5m_bps, count() AS fills
FROM r ORDER BY hr

WITH a AS (
  SELECT f.trade_id, f.ts, f.symbol, f.venue, f.trader, f.passive, f.qty, f.px, (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 AS mid_15m
  FROM energy_fills f HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source) LIST (15m) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @spike AND f.curve IN ('NBP', 'UKPWR', 'TTF')
), b AS (
  SELECT f.trade_id, (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 AS mid_30m
  FROM energy_fills f HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source) LIST (30m) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @spike AND f.curve IN ('NBP', 'UKPWR', 'TTF')
)
SELECT a.ts, a.symbol, a.venue, a.trader, CASE WHEN a.passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS style,
       CASE WHEN a.qty > 0 THEN 'buy' ELSE 'sell' END AS side, abs(a.qty) AS qty, a.px,
       round(CASE WHEN a.qty > 0 THEN a.mid_15m - a.px ELSE a.px - a.mid_15m END / a.px * 10000, 1) AS markout_15m_bps,
       round(CASE WHEN a.qty > 0 THEN b.mid_30m - a.px ELSE a.px - b.mid_30m END / a.px * 10000, 1) AS markout_30m_bps
FROM a JOIN b ON a.trade_id = b.trade_id ORDER BY a.ts
cells.name: Fills in the spike window (NBP / UK power / TTF) with 15m and 30m markouts

WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.trader, f.book, f.passive, f.symbol, h.offset / 1000000000 AS horizon_s,
    CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / f.px * 10000 AS bps,
    CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(f.qty) AS pnl_local
  FROM energy_fills f HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source) LIST (0, 300s, 900s) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @day
), a AS (
  SELECT r.trader, r.book, r.passive, r.horizon_s, count() AS n, avg(r.bps) AS avg_bps, stddev_samp(r.bps) AS sd, sum(r.pnl_local * u.factor) AS pnl_usd
  FROM r JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON u.symbol = r.symbol
)
SELECT trader, book, CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS style, max(n) AS fills,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 0 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS slippage_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_5m_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN avg_bps / (sd / sqrt(n)) ELSE 0 END), 1) AS t_stat_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 900 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_15m_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN pnl_usd ELSE 0 END)) AS markout_5m_usd,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 900 THEN pnl_usd ELSE 0 END)) AS markout_15m_usd
FROM a ORDER BY markout_15m_usd
cells.name: Trader scorecard · worst 15m mark-to-market first

WITH t AS ((SELECT trade_id, trade_ts, symbol, curve, counterparty, channel, qty, px FROM (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE trade_ts IN @day AND channel != 'EXCH' LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id) WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)),
r1 AS (
  SELECT t.counterparty, t.channel, t.symbol, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_s,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / t.px * 10000 AS bps,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(t.qty) AS pnl_local
  FROM t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source = 'ICE') LIST (0, 5m, 30m, 2h) AS h
  WHERE t.curve NOT IN ('WTI', 'TTF', 'EUA')
), r2 AS (
  SELECT t.counterparty, t.channel, t.symbol, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_s,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / t.px * 10000 AS bps,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(t.qty) AS pnl_local
  FROM t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source = 'ICE_ENDEX') LIST (0, 5m, 30m, 2h) AS h
  WHERE t.curve IN ('TTF', 'EUA')
), r3 AS (
  SELECT t.counterparty, t.channel, t.symbol, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_s,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / t.px * 10000 AS bps,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(t.qty) AS pnl_local
  FROM t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source = 'CME') LIST (0, 5m, 30m, 2h) AS h
  WHERE t.curve = 'WTI'
), r AS (SELECT * FROM r1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM r2 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM r3),
a AS (
  SELECT r.counterparty, r.horizon_s, count() AS n, avg(r.bps) AS avg_bps, stddev_samp(r.bps) AS sd, sum(r.pnl_local * u.factor) AS pnl_usd
  FROM r JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON u.symbol = r.symbol
)
SELECT counterparty, max(n) AS trades,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 0 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS slippage_vs_screen_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_5m_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_30m_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN avg_bps / (sd / sqrt(n)) ELSE 0 END), 1) AS t_stat_30m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 7200 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_2h_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN pnl_usd ELSE 0 END)) AS markout_30m_usd
FROM a ORDER BY markout_30m_usd
cells.name: OTC / broker counterparties · price vs primary-venue screen mid at trade time (session)

WITH t AS ((SELECT trade_id, trade_ts, symbol, curve, channel, qty, px, regexp_replace(counterparty, '_[0-9]+$', '') AS cpty_type FROM (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE trade_ts IN @cpty_window AND channel != 'EXCH' LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id) WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)),
r1 AS (
  SELECT t.cpty_type, t.channel, t.symbol, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_s,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / t.px * 10000 AS bps,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(t.qty) AS pnl_local
  FROM t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source = 'ICE') LIST (0, 5m, 30m, 2h) AS h
  WHERE t.curve NOT IN ('WTI', 'TTF', 'EUA')
), r2 AS (
  SELECT t.cpty_type, t.channel, t.symbol, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_s,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / t.px * 10000 AS bps,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(t.qty) AS pnl_local
  FROM t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source = 'ICE_ENDEX') LIST (0, 5m, 30m, 2h) AS h
  WHERE t.curve IN ('TTF', 'EUA')
), r3 AS (
  SELECT t.cpty_type, t.channel, t.symbol, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_s,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / t.px * 10000 AS bps,
    CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(t.qty) AS pnl_local
  FROM t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source = 'CME') LIST (0, 5m, 30m, 2h) AS h
  WHERE t.curve = 'WTI'
), r AS (SELECT * FROM r1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM r2 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM r3),
a AS (
  SELECT r.cpty_type, r.channel, r.horizon_s, count() AS n, avg(r.bps) AS avg_bps, stddev_samp(r.bps) AS sd, sum(r.pnl_local * u.factor) AS pnl_usd
  FROM r JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON u.symbol = r.symbol
)
SELECT cpty_type, channel, max(n) AS trades,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 0 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS slippage_vs_screen_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_5m_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN avg_bps / (sd / sqrt(n)) ELSE 0 END), 1) AS t_stat_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_30m_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN avg_bps / (sd / sqrt(n)) ELSE 0 END), 1) AS t_stat_30m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 7200 THEN avg_bps ELSE 0 END), 2) AS markout_2h_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN pnl_usd ELSE 0 END)) AS markout_30m_usd
FROM a ORDER BY cpty_type, channel
cells.name: Counterparty type × channel · markouts over @cpty_window (more trades per cell)

WITH r AS (
  SELECT 'current' AS which, f.venue, f.passive, count() AS n,
    avg(CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / f.px * 10000) AS bps
  FROM energy_fills f HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source) LIST (300s) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @day
), p AS (
  SELECT 'previous' AS which, f.venue, f.passive, count() AS n,
    avg(CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END / f.px * 10000) AS bps
  FROM energy_fills f HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source) LIST (300s) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @prev_day
)
SELECT r.venue, CASE WHEN r.passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS style, r.n AS fills_today, round(r.bps, 2) AS markout_5m_today, p.n AS fills_prev, round(p.bps, 2) AS markout_5m_prev, round(r.bps - p.bps, 2) AS change_bps
FROM r JOIN p ON r.venue = p.venue AND r.passive = p.passive ORDER BY r.venue, style
cells.name: Day over day · 5m markout by venue (@day vs @prev_day)

WITH r AS (SELECT f.venue, f.curve, (f.ts - q.ts) / 1000000000.0 AS age_s FROM energy_fills f ASOF JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source) WHERE f.ts IN @day)
SELECT venue, curve, count() AS fills, round(avg(age_s), 2) AS avg_quote_age_s, round(max(age_s), 1) AS max_quote_age_s,
       sum(CASE WHEN age_s > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fills_quote_older_10s, sum(CASE WHEN age_s > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fills_quote_older_60s
FROM r ORDER BY max_quote_age_s DESC
cells.name: Data quality · age of the venue quote at fill time (stale quotes = noisy markouts)

SELECT channel, count() AS trades, round(avg(datediff('m', trade_ts, booked_ts)), 0) AS avg_booking_lag_min, max(datediff('m', trade_ts, booked_ts)) AS max_booking_lag_min,
       sum(CASE WHEN datediff('m', trade_ts, booked_ts) > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked_over_1h_late,
       sum(CASE WHEN timestamp_floor('d', booked_ts) > timestamp_floor('d', trade_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked_next_day
FROM energy_trade_events WHERE trade_ts IN @day AND status = 'NEW' ORDER BY channel
